content: Akali Jotame Easa Esekayamoo dusipa Juta rara dokona kiŋi yulu pyuo kareyaminyi yuu gii dokopa Kamongo Anatumi akali Maeka yuu Moresete range doko pii lamaiyamo dupwa buku dakena pyasi palamo. Kamongo dokome pii dasipa yuu Samaria Jerusaleme dolapona ingyuo Maeka nolakao lamaiya.
Samaria Jerusalemepa Randa Nyerambilyamo Lao Ee Lao Ingi Randaya

content.text: Wambu peparae nakama pii dake selapape.
Isa yuu panda karaminyi dupwa peparaeme pii dake selapape.
Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa dokome nakama koo pimiŋi lao
banya yake panda tembole anda dokona karo, lara.
Kamongo doko banya yuu poo pyasi dokona piso epelyamo.
Isa epapala yuu kyau ketae dupwana kata papira.
Papiramo dokopa yuu kyau moko kararamo dupwa rao lili lao ipwa ingyapala
yuu lama lama dupwana kyau ipwa lyuo epele lao epara.

content: Yulu dopa piramo renge doko Isaraele wambu dupwame Anatu kando koo pyuo kamba lao karaminyi dokona ingyuo pira. Isaraele wambumi kamba lami dokona apinya rengendena pilyamo laramisi? Samaria wambu keta palamo. Api mendeme yuu Juta dokona mee bange anatu lao lakando koo pyuo karase? Jerusaleme wambu dupwame koo doko pilyaminyi.

Dokona lao Kamongo dokome letamo. Nambame yuu Samaria taone dupwa kokwa seronopa anda muku dokona isa girapo wara pyuo narami. Nambame taone kaname pisi dupwa pyao sinjimu ingyapala lama dokona kulimbwanyi nembaronopa susa kana dupwa iki sera.

Nakamana mee bange yapasi lapo anatu ingyuo retenge dupwa pyao kokwa soo inji ranji pyuo para. Bange peparae tembole anda dokona pamuku yulu pinya lao maimi dupwa isareme yango kokwa sinyi nembaro. Dopa pipala mee bange anatu lao kingimi wasisi dupwa pyao mee bange inginyi nembaro. Samaria wambu dupwame bange dupwa nyepala anatu lao pyuo karapala Anatu angi doko kando koo pyuo kareyami dupwa epapu nakamana yanda pimwai dupwame bange dupwa nyuo yuu wakale lapona paraminyipa anatuŋu lao misi lele lao kararami.

Dokopa Maekame dopa leya. Dopa pira dokona suu pyao namba ee lao ingi randarolyamo. Namba sakalyo lao nolako dokopa kimbu suu pii nao mee papara karo piru. Namba yana suwa kararope wua londe lenge dopale ingyuo lao yaka ulyakili pii ketae lenge dopale ingyuo ee poraiyuo ketae larolyamo.

Dokona lao Samaria wambunya randa dupwa kapa umbwa pii nara ingilyamo. Juta wambu dupwa randa mendare nyerami ingyapya doko epapu angi Jerusaleme kame kambu dokona sukusa nambana wambu palenge dokona oo pyaka silyamo.
Yanda Pimwai Dupwa Jerusaleme Epo Pyaka Sela Epeyami

Namwa nyuo isa palyuo kaeyasi petamano doko Gati wambu dupwa lamai nalapa. Ee lao petene laope kanda nana lao pisipwa. Wambu yuu Bete Leapora range dupwa mende pirami ingya nalyamo doko lasaka pyuo dokopa yuu sinjimu dokona kimu kiki pyuo bai bai pipwape.

Nakama yuu Sapia range dupwa papara elya nyuo yuu wakale mendena karapusi pyao lanyuo parami. Yuu taone andake Sanane palenge wambu dupwa pakapala neta epa narami. Nakama yuu Betesele wambu dupwa ee lao kumaralerale nyiyami kande doko sepala nakama range kana lambo mendena pao lyolo pii naramalyamo lao suu pyalapape.
Yuu Marote range wambu dupwa Kamongo dokome Jerusaleme nakamana yuu repeta doko randa maiyamo kandapala nakama manda rao kiiramo pumwali yaka lao ingi randayami.

Yuu Lakisi palenge wambu dupwa nakamana mena oseme ipyuo penge uliuli doko yapa lao kimbu selapape. Nakama Isaraele wambunya koo dupwa makande minyuo pipala Jerusaleme doko yulu koo pinya lao lasaka piyami.
Epapu Juta wambu dupwa nakama yuu Moresete Gati doko range sepe lalapape. Dokona lao Isaraele kiŋi dupwa yuu taone Akisipi dokome kapa nyisara ingya nalyamo.

Nakama Maresa wambu dupwa Kamongo dokome lao, Baame nakama minyuo pao yanda pimwai keta pyamalyeronopa yanda pimwai dupwa epo nakama pyao nembo nakamana yuu taone doko nyerami letamo. Dopa piraminyipa Isaraele kiŋi dupwa ralo pao yuu Atalame kana anda dokona yalu pirami.

Juta wambu dupwa nakamana wane wanake mona retenge dupwa suu pyao kyawasi angasipi pyao kumanda pisipwape. Nakamana wane wanake dupwa nyuo minyuo parami dupwana suu pyao nakamana kyawasi angasipi pyao yaka dopo yamanji akusuli doo pisirami.
